subject: Meridian: commercial pathing + procurement gating (timeline proposal)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Coleman <ethan.coleman@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@catalystpartners.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Meridian discovery — procurement gating recap + proposed timeline

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for a productive call this morning — appreciate the clarity on your use cases for chart summarization and clinical note generation. Quick recap and proposed next steps focused on procurement so your team can pick the easiest commercial path.

High-level recap:
- Primary commercial ask: production-grade inference for clinical summarization integrated into Meridian EHR.
- Expected throughput: 2–4 qps steady, burst to 8 qps.
- Data controls: VPC + customer-managed KMS preferred for PHI.

Procurement options you mentioned (we hear you):
1) PO (corporate purchase order) + MPA — preferred by Finance; standard for enterprise implementations.
2) Corporate card (self-serve) — faster, but hit monthly transaction limits and no MPA.
3) Cloud marketplace listing (AWS Marketplace) — good runway if your procurement team prefers subscription invoicing via marketplace billing.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and timeline (suggested):
- Legal review of MPA: target complete by 2026-09-15 (one week)
- Security questionnaire + evidence collection (SOC2 audit report, network diagram): target complete by 2026-09-22
- Finance approval and PO issuance: target by 2026-09-29
- Kickoff and onboarding: target week of 2026-10-05

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with milestone owners) and Commercial_Term_Sheet_v1.xlsx (starter term sheet + pricing example).

Questions for you to confirm so we can prioritize our internal ops:
- Which path should we prioritize (PO vs card vs marketplace)?
- Who will own the security questionnaire on your side (name + email)?
- Any hard dates we should align to for a go-live window in October?

If helpful, I can loop in our Procurement lead (Ben) and Solutions lead (Monica) to accelerate MPA and security packaging.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Strategic Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0136

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF, 34KB)
Attachment: Commercial_Term_Sheet_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 16KB)

From: Ethan Coleman <ethan.coleman@meridianhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 11:01:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Meridian discovery — procurement gating recap + proposed timeline

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear writeup and the proposed dates. A few answers inline: 

- Procurement path: Finance prefers PO + MPA. Marketplace is something we can evaluate later, but PO is the path of least resistance for this initial deployment.
- Security owner: I’ll have our InfoSec lead, Priya Kulkarni (priya.kulkarni@meridianhealth.com), own the questionnaire and evidence collection. I’ll introduce her once we have the initial package.
- Go-live: October week of 10/5 is realistic as long as legal and security close on your suggested cadence.

I’ve looped Procurement as well (procurement@meridianhealth.com) so they’re aware of the timeline and can prep PO paperwork.

Appreciate the attachments — will review and come back with any contract redlines.

Regards,
Ethan
Director of Digital Health | Meridian Health

Team — quick internal note following Meridian thread above. They are leaning PO + MPA as the primary route; InfoSec owner is Priya Kulkarni. They asked for our MPA + term sheet (attached).

Decision points we need to resolve ASAP:

3) Finance flow: Ben, please confirm the invoice header details we should ask Procurement to include on the PO (W-9, remit address, tax ID). If you want, I can paste a sample PO template in the reply.

Suggested tactical next steps (I’ll run these unless you push back):

- Ben/Monica: please reply by EOD Monday 9/13 with the three quick answers above.
